facts.premium: Highland border province; ~90% informal, tourism gives seasonal pay bumps.
facts.skill_gap: Tourism/hospitality jobs are seasonal; limited year-round formal employment.
anchors: Highland tourism (Chiang Khan, Phu Kradueng, cool-season travel)
Rice, cassava, corn and rubber/tea on the uplands
workers: Farmers (rice, corn, rubber) and farm labour
impacts: Chiang Khan/Phu Kradueng draw peak-season spending and informal-trade income.
Rain-fed upland crops make harvest income weather-dependent.
Corn and cassava prices weak YoY; rubber firmer — mixed farm income.
Income concentrates in the cool months, leaving thin off-season cash flow.
Mekong crossings to Laos support some trader income.
